method: Complete pinned generator source read; Git blob and SHA256 verified. No generated script or mutating action executed.
findings: Generator default handler order is cmd,remove; cmd only emits when user command configured. Clone/link presets try ordered filesystem-capable alternatives. Invalid names log errors but parsing continues, potentially leaving empty handler list.

File/duplicate/original output arguments escape apostrophes using standard single-quote close/doublequote/reopen sequence. Header cwd/argv/binary/user/group fields use different template contexts and are interpolated without the same path escape routine; full arbitrary-path roundtrip remains unqualified.

Every is_original row replaces a retained last_original reference. Following duplicate rows use that state rather than an explicit group ID; correct grouping relies on ordered upstream output. Non-original before any original silently emits no action.

Clone/reflink generation inspects live filesystem link types and mount capabilities at generation time; runtime changes require separate checks in generated handlers. Same-device inode match emits skip_hardlink without fresh runtime identity validation.

line_count increments for duplicate records even if no handler emitted. Footer Done/progress is therefore not an action-count success receipt. Footer seeks to rewrite a fixed progress field and checks fseek!=-1 rather than standard success==0; no seek failure control run.
For stream output footer returns before unref of retained last_original; ordinary file output releases it. Most fprintf/fchmod failures are ignored or logged without a propagated formatter status.
limits: Source-level findings, not arbitrary-path or cleanup runtime reproduction.
